falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 cash index closes at least 4.0% above today's close on any session within 14 days, with VIX closing below 16 on the same day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A confirmed upside resolution would falsify HOLD/UNKNOWN: the bottom_2024_aug analogue would have already triggered and a flat call would have missed a directional long.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 cash index closes more than 3.0% below the lowest daily close of the prior 20 sessions, and VIX closes above 28 on that same day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A fresh breakdown with a vol spike would falsify both the 77% bottom_2024_aug match and HOLD: the pattern would be a failed base, not an unresolved bottom.

falsification_conditions.condition: HY OAS (ICE BofA US High Yield option-adjusted spread) widens by 75 bps or more versus today's close and stays at least 50 bps wider on the day-14 close
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent credit stress would falsify UNKNOWN/HOLD by forcing a risk-off regime call; a bottom analogue cannot remain unresolved if credit confirms stress rather than repair.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
